DURING AN INSPECTION OF YOUR FIRM (I) (WE) OBSERVED:
Observation 2: The firm is not testing each donation for evidence of infection due to relevant transfusion
transmitted infections (RTTI). Specifically, when a donor tests reactive for an RTTI on one donation, additional
donation(s) made after that donation and prior to the time the donor is permanently deferred are not tested for
RTTI. Samples from some subsequent donations are not shipped to the firm's contact testing laboratory after a
reactive test result is obtained and testing orders are cancelled.
